title: Toddler Talk - Videos
description:
Hi. My name is Stephanie. I'm a licensed Speech-Language Pathologist in California with a Master's Degree in Speech-Language Pathology from Columbia University. 

Over the past 3 years, I have teamed up with a group of moms and speech therapists to create Toddler Talk, the most comprehensive and reliable online resources for parents of toddlers looking to support communication development. I am excited to share what you can expect in your child's early communication development and what you can expect in speech therapy with your toddler. I will also share community resources for toddlers, strategies to elicit talking, and how to manage at home practice within your busy day to day life!
